processes.name: Dealer Order Intake & Quoting
processes.description: Manages dealer requests, generates quotes using Excel pricing workbooks, and routes approvals to sales management before dealers set retail prices.
pain_points: Dealer-set retail prices create margin uncertainty

processes.name: Production Scheduling & Shop Floor Execution
processes.description: Coordinates weekly setup, tracks orders via Excel and whiteboard, manages paper work orders through the shop, and handles change orders or material shortages.

processes.name: Purchasing, Receiving & Inventory Control
processes.description: Manages supplier orders via Excel and Outlook, processes paper receiving records, maintains stock sheets, and reconciles counts with QuickBooks for bills.
pain_points: Excel stock sheets vs QuickBooks mismatch

processes.name: Manufacturing, Inspection & Dealer Delivery
processes.description: Oversees frame cutting, welding, painting, assembly, and final inspection matching dealer-specified options before shipping to independent dealers.
pain_points: Final inspection must match dealer options
Status call handling adds admin load

processes.name: Warranty Processing & Dealer Claims Support
processes.description: Routes dealer-reported issues to quality leads, evaluates claims case-by-case without blanket rules, and approves repairs before execution.
pain_points: No blanket coverage rule requires case-by-case review

processes.name: Financial Close & Payroll Administration
processes.description: Consolidates cutoff records, reviews monthly financials within a target window, and processes biweekly payroll by splitting two workweeks for accurate overtime calculation.
pain_points: Biweekly payroll requires splitting workweeks manually
